response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId AS raceId, r.name AS name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), with_name_avg AS (SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY name) AS name_avg FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, avg_points / NULLIF(name_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM with_name_avg ORDER BY (avg_points / NULLIF(name_avg, 0)) IS NULL ASC, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The race-name average is the unweighted mean of per-race averages (each race counts once) among races that have at least one constructor result with points > 1.0; races without such results are excluded.
Ratio is NULL when the name average is 0 (division guarded by NULLIF), and NULL ratios sort last. Ties in ratio are left in arbitrary order.
